## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a safe, automated model rollout using Vertex AI without downtime, including precise traffic controls and rollback criteria. Emphasizes artifact management, monitoring, and least-privilege IAM.

## Key Concepts
- Vertex AI endpoints and traffic splitting
- Canary and automatic rollback thresholds
- Cloud Monitoring for latency and error-rate alerts
- Cloud Storage as model artifact storage
- Least-privilege IAM for deployment pipelines

gsutil cp model_v2.tar.gz gs://my-bucket/models/v2/

# Register model and deploy on a new endpoint
